question: In the Th2-B cooperation process, what does the Th2 cell recognize on the surface of the B cell?

options.opa: The antigen bound to a surface immunoglobulin.
options.opb: A fragment of antigen bound to the CD21 molecule.
options.opd: A fragment of antigen bound to a class II histocompatibility molecule.
options.ope: A fragment of antigen bound to a class I histocompatibility molecule.
